report.explanation: All observed checkout requests returned 200 with mostly low latency; one 344ms outlier is not established as a fault. Traces show healthy downstream spans and no errors. No evidence substantiates any taxonomy cause; operator hypothesis of a fault is contradicted by healthy telemetry, so hand off for more evidence.
